2026-27 Preseason Schedule

PWHL TRAINING CAMPS TO OPEN NOVEMBER 18

All 12 teams to each play two Preseason Scrimmages Nov. 22-30 

Action will take place across five markets with live stats available at thepwhl.com along with updates across league and team social media channels. Details regarding fan access to preseason scrimmages will be announced at a later date by host teams.
